run_skills_browse: browse all available skills across registries with pagination and source filtering
run_skills_search: search skill registries for skills matching a query string
run_skills_install: install a skill from a registry with quarantine, security scan, and user confirmation
run_skills_inspect: preview a skill's metadata and SKILL.md content without installing it
run_skills_list: list all installed skills distinguishing hub, builtin, and local sources
run_skills_check: check hub-installed skills for available upstream updates
run_skills_update: update hub-installed skills with upstream changes
run_skills_audit: re-run security scan on installed hub skills
run_skills_uninstall: remove a hub-installed skill with confirmation
run_skills_publish: publish a local skill to a GitHub repo via pull request
run_skills_snapshot_export: export current hub skill configuration and taps to a portable JSON file
run_skills_snapshot_import: re-install skills and restore taps from a snapshot JSON file
run_skills_tap: manage custom GitHub repo sources for skill discovery
run_skills_reset: reset bundled skill manifest tracking and optionally restore from bundled source
run_skills_command: route hermes skills CLI subcommands to their handler functions
run_skills_slash: parse and dispatch /skills slash commands from the interactive chat interface
run_browse_skills: browse paginated hub skills for programmatic callers returning structured dict
run_inspect_skill: retrieve skill metadata and SKILL.md preview for programmatic callers
